browser: Actual macOS Safari app com.apple.Safari, native keyboard control; 1512x770 CSS viewport, devicePixelRatio 2.
method: Two isolated production builds served sequentially on 127.0.0.1:3001. Each version was opened once without diagnostics, then fully navigated to audit=viewer. The same native-control batch sent six Right keypresses, each followed by an accessibility snapshot, starting immediately after initial UI state. Probe freezes after 20 seconds. Existing HTTP image cache was retained.

before.method: Real input; callback intervals, not GPU presentation. Moving gaps include stalls over 80ms.

after.method: Real input; callback intervals, not GPU presentation. Moving gaps include stalls over 80ms.

limits: One local run per build, warm assets, foreground/background OS scheduling and accessibility snapshot overhead; results are not universal FPS guarantees.
RAF intervals measure callback opportunities, not physical GPU presentation. Native transform/opacity playback may continue without these JS callbacks.
presented events mean a decoded preview was committed to React state, not a physical screen-presentation timestamp.
viewerMountedAtMs is relative to full document navigation; it is not time to finished entrance animation.
DOM photo MiB is a natural-dimension estimate for current image elements only, not process, off-DOM cache, video or GPU memory.
Average page P95 and input queue P95 did not improve in this run. Preview decoding waits increased from approximately 1ms to 13ms under the more conservative prefetch schedule.

verification.productionBuild: Both before and final after builds passed in temporary copies; original .next left intact.
cacheChecks: Decoded image object retained and reused
